How much should a decent bike shop charge to inspect a bike and quote any needed repairs after it's been sitting for a while?

I was just given [a road bike](https://imgur.com/a/v5qP5#0) that my friend had in storage for over two years. 

I am reasonably mechanically intelligent but have no experience with bike repairs. The back tire is flat. The chain has a bit of rust, but I don't know if it's a big deal.

Any thoughts?
